description: This source file defines the 'TrieBasedPolicyEnforcer' class, which implements a policy enforcement mechanism based on trie data structures for efficient permission and revocation checks. It includes methods for creating instances from policies, querying permissions for subjects/resources, and building JSON views of resources based on permissions. The class leverages various trie-based data structures to represent policy hierarchies and permissions.

classes.name: TrieBasedPolicyEnforcer
classes.description: A final class implementing the Enforcer interface, providing trie-based policy enforcement including permission checks, subject retrieval, and JSON view building. It encapsulates hierarchical policy representations through various specialized trie structures for efficient authorization logic.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Constructs a new TrieBasedPolicyEnforcer from a given Policy object, ensuring the policy is not null.

methods.name: hasUnrestrictedPermissions
methods.description: Checks if the resource (or its sub-resources) has unrestricted permissions for the given authorization context and permissions, using revoke trie policies.

methods.name: hasPartialPermissions
methods.description: Determines whether the resource (or sub-resources) have partial permissions granted, based on the grant trie policies.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves subject IDs with specified permissions on a given resource key, inherited if exact resource path is not found.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves the full set of subjects with specified permissions for a resource key.

methods.name: getSubjectIdsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Gets IDs of subjects with partial permissions for a resource.

methods.name: getSubjectsWithPartialPermission
methods.description: Gets full subject objects with partial permissions for a resource.

methods.name: buildJsonView
methods.description: Constructs a JSON view of a resource considering permissions and authorization context, based on the inherited trie.
